他明明记得中午时这些草药还绿油油的旺盛不已，这才一个下午，怎么可能会变成这样。他抓起枯萎的蓝线草，凝神一望，从这蓝线草的外貌上看，它是失去了全部水分，所以干枯，他面上露出沉思之色，摸了摸地上的泥土，发现泥土很湿润，完全符合草药生长的环境，这让他惊疑起来。
许久之后忽然目光一闪，喃喃自语道：“今天下午，我这里只来了一人，可他一个记名弟子，怎么会让这些草药干枯呢？”
想到这里，他决定查探一番，二话不说袖子一甩，身子顿时飘起，脚下浮现七彩祥云，迅速离开正院，不大一会，他就来到记名弟子的杂务处。
“此地哪个弟子负责？”孙长老低喝一声，顿时化作阵阵雷鸣，负责此地的刘姓黄衣弟子连忙从房间奔跑出来，吓的面无血色，噗通一声跪在地上，不住的磕头。
孙长老皱起眉头，不耐烦道：“你这里可有王林的登记？”
刘姓弟子内心“咯噔”一下，他怎么也没想到高高在上的长老居然会亲来此地询问一个废物，惊恐之下想到以前对王林的刁难，顿时面色惨白，寒蝉若惊道：“弟子……有……有王林师弟的登记，王师弟勤奋好学，每次做工作都是认认真真，弟子……弟子心里一直以他为榜样……楷模……我……”
孙长老哭笑不得，但内心却极为受用，对方越是紧张，说明越是敬怕他，要知道恒岳派长老其实很不值钱，所有二代弟子，都是长老，当然这称呼是对记名弟子来说的，若是内门弟子，则大都称呼师叔。
他虽说在记名弟子眼中是长老，可实际上在二代弟子中没啥地位，实力也属于末流，就连三代弟子心里也都瞧不上他。
不然也不会安排他负责无关紧要的记名弟子回家探亲的申请工作。
板着脸，孙长老沉声道：“王林居住之地在哪个院子？”
“在……在北角的土字副院……”
没等他说完，孙长老身子一动，化作长虹向北方遁去，眨眼间就看不到踪影。
刘姓弟子心里更紧张了，肠子都快悔青了，他暗自发誓以后再看到王林，一定不能像以前那样嘲讽，必须要好好的溜须拍马，把他当自家亲爷爷一样伺候，人家可是长老都亲自过问的红人啊。
孙长老在来到土字副院后，神识一扫，没有发现王林，略一沉吟，进入登记处查看一番，找到王林居住的房屋号，便直奔而去，张虎正呼呼的大睡，对于孙长老的到来没有半点察觉。
神识在房间仔细的探查一番，孙长老眉头紧皱，喃喃自语道：“走的好快，哼，等他回来后，再查看也是一样。”
王林行走在山间，腿上贴着仙符，这仙符果然神奇，贴在身上后一股热乎乎的气流从上面钻进身体内，聚集在双脚，闪耀刺眼的白光，远远看去，仿若真的仙人一般。
尤其是山林内的野兽，一看到这白光，便一个个迅速远离，不敢接近。
轻风扑面，山间空气清新，王林心情愉悦，脚步飞快，按照记忆中的方向不停的赶路。
一夜无话，第二天清晨天微微亮，他喝了口葫芦里的泉水，精力充沛后回头一看，发现已经走出了山林，约莫再有一些路程就可到县城，到时顺着小路就能回到村子。

也不停留，他大步流星迅速前行，天色大亮时，他进入县城，此时正好是集市，人头涌涌热闹非凡，王林四处溜达一圈，买了一些给父母的礼物，便匆匆离开。
日上三竿之时，王林终于回到了村子，他远远的就看见家中挂起高高的红色长福，上面写着一个大大的寿字。
门外马车众多，人来人往好不热闹。
王林一怔，身子迅速临至，在家门外停了下来，他出现的场面太过惊人，聚集在王林家前来祝寿的亲戚们，只看到一道白光闪过，接着王林就出现在他们面前。
所有人都面露羡慕之色，纷纷夸奖起来。
“二哥，王林回来了，你看看这孩子，真是一表人才，看起来就是仙人料子。”
“可不是嘛，当初仙人看走了眼，后来不也后悔了，直接把王林收为弟子，咱们王家以后就全靠他们三个孩子了。”

Puzzled, he walked in and took a closer look, and found that not only the blue-lined grass, but also the purple nightflower opposite was withered to varying degrees, but not as serious as the blue-lined grass.
He clearly remembered that these herbs were still green and vigorous at noon. How could it be like this in just one afternoon. He grabbed the withered blue thread grass and took a closer look. Judging from the appearance of the blue thread grass, it had lost all its moisture and was therefore dry. A look of contemplation appeared on his face. He touched the soil on the ground and found that the soil was very moist, which was completely consistent with the environment in which herbs grow. This made him suspicious.
After a long time, his eyes suddenly flashed and he murmured to himself: "I only have one person here this afternoon, but how can he, a registered disciple, let these herbs dry up?"
Thinking of this, he decided to investigate. Without saying a word, he flicked his sleeves, and his body suddenly floated up. Colorful auspicious clouds appeared under his feet. He quickly left the main courtyard. After a while, he came to the miscellaneous office of the registered disciples.
"Which disciple is in charge here?" Elder Sun shouted, which suddenly turned into bursts of thunder. The yellow-clothed disciple named Liu who was in charge of this place quickly ran out of the room, his face turned pale with fright, and he knelt on the ground with a thud, kowtowing continuously.
Elder Sun frowned and said impatiently: "Do you have Wang Lin's registration here?"
The disciple surnamed Liu felt a thump in his heart. He never expected that the superior elder would actually come here to question a loser. He thought of the difficulties he had faced against Wang Lin in the past, and his face turned pale. He said in shock, "Disciple... I have... Junior Brother Wang Lin's registration. Junior Brother Wang is diligent and studious. He takes his work seriously every time. Disciple... Disciple has always regarded him as a role model... a role model... I..."
Elder Sun couldn't laugh or cry, but he felt extremely happy inside. The more nervous the other party was, the more he respected and feared him. You must know that the elders of the Hengyue Sect are actually very worthless. All second-generation disciples are elders. Of course, this title is for registered disciples. If they are inner disciples, most of them call them uncle.
Although he is considered an elder in the eyes of the registered disciples, he actually has no status among the second-generation disciples, and his strength is at the bottom of the heap. Even the third-generation disciples do not look down upon him.
Otherwise, he would not be assigned the task of applying for unimportant registered disciples to go home to visit relatives.
With a straight face, Elder Sun said in a deep voice: "Which courtyard is Wang Lin's residence in?"
"In...in the Vice-Yuan with Tu character in North Point..."
Before he could finish speaking, Elder Sun moved, turned into a rainbow and fled towards the north, disappearing in the blink of an eye.
The disciple surnamed Liu became even more nervous, and his intestines almost turned green. He secretly swore that when he saw Wang Lin in the future, he would not taunt Wang Lin like before. He must flatter him and serve him like his own grandfather. He was a famous person who even the elders personally looked after.
After Elder Sun arrived at the Tuzi Vice-Yard, he scanned his consciousness and did not find Wang Lin. He pondered for a while, entered the registration office to check, found the house number where Wang Lin lived, and went straight away. Zhang Hu was sleeping soundly and was not aware of Elder Sun's arrival.
After carefully exploring the room with his spiritual sense, Elder Sun frowned and murmured to himself: "He walked so fast, huh, it will be the same when I check again after he comes back."
Wang Lin was walking in the mountains with an immortal talisman attached to his legs. This immortal talisman was indeed magical. After it was attached to his body, a stream of hot air penetrated his body from above and gathered on his feet, shining with dazzling white light. From a distance, he looked like a real immortal.
Especially the wild beasts in the mountains and forests, as soon as they saw this white light, they quickly moved away and did not dare to approach.
The gentle breeze blew against his face, and the air in the mountains was fresh. Wang Lin was in a happy mood, walking quickly, and kept walking in the direction he remembered.
The whole night was silent, and the next morning it was slightly bright, and he took a sip of the spring in the gourd.When I was full of energy, I looked back and found that I had walked out of the mountains and forests. It would be a little further to reach the county seat, and then I could follow the path back to the village.
Without stopping, he strode forward quickly. When it was daylight, he entered the county town. It happened to be the market at that time, and it was crowded and lively. Wang Lin walked around, bought some gifts for his parents, and left in a hurry.
At three o'clock in the morning, Wang Lin finally returned to the village. From a distance, he saw a tall red long blessing hanging in his home, with a big word "longevity" written on it.
There were many carriages outside the door, and it was very lively with people coming and going.
Wang Lin was startled, and he quickly approached and stopped outside his home. The scene he appeared in was so shocking that the relatives who gathered at Wang Lin's house to celebrate his birthday only saw a flash of white light, and then Wang Lin appeared in front of them.
Everyone looked envious and praised him one after another.
"Second brother, Wang Lin is back. Look at this kid. He is really talented. He looks like the stuff of an immortal."
"Isn't that right? The immortal misjudged him at first, but later he regretted it and directly accepted Wang Lin as his disciple. From now on, our Wang family will rely entirely on these three children."
